fact: Mayotte Hebdo says police arrested Al-Watwan correspondent Abdou Moustoifa on 17 November 2025 over a Facebook post about migrants held in a Moroni police station and questioned him for over two hours to learn his source.

Mayotte Hebdo says the Comorian press mobilised in December 2025 against a ministry and CNPA proposal to amend article 169 of the Information Code on source protection, and the journalists' union SNJC obtained its withdrawal.

CIVICUS Monitor reports that the National Union of Comorian Journalists, media and rights defenders opposed draft article 169 of the Information Code, which would have let a judge compel journalists to reveal sources, and MPs rejected it on 26 December 2025.
